results.title: Mertens' first theorem
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $\Lambda$ be the von Mangoldt function and $\psi(x)=\sum_{n\le x}\Lambda(n)$. For every real $x\ge0$, $\psi(x)\le3x$. For every real $x\ge1$, \Bigl|\sum_{n\le x}\frac{\Lambda(n)}{n}-\log x\Bigr|\le3 .$$

results.title: The twisted sum and $L(1,\chi)$
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $q\ge1$, let $\chi$ be a nonprincipal Dirichlet character modulo $q$, put $M=\log q+3$, and for real $x$ let T_\chi(x)=\sum_{n\le x}\frac{\chi(n)\log n}{n}.$$ Then for every real $x\ge1$, and hence, as $L(1,\chi)\ne0$, $|S_\chi(x)|\le(M^2+6q)/|L(1,\chi)|$.
